notes: Two isnads carry the same saying: each is its own group, and the second repeats the names (rule 4)
«عمر بن الخطاب» asks inside Hudhayfa's story: he is in the scene only, and the saying relayed is the Prophet's, so Hudhayfa is the last link (rules 5, 6)
«‏.» between the two isnads is an editor's break, not a name
